fields.v: Yes (1): eight models (and three scaffolds) evaluated as alternatives on the same 217 instances, checklists, scaffold defaults and judges; no 'no-instruction' baseline condition
fields.quote: We evaluate 8 models (MiniMax-M2.1, MiniMax-M2, Kimi-K2Thinking, ChatGLM-4.6, Claude-Sonnet-4.5, Claude-Opus-4.5, Doubao-Seed-1.8, Gemini-3Pro) across 3 scaffold environments. Each instance is run 3 times per model.
fields.why: Q7 asks for a baseline or an alternative under the same conditions; eight models under identical conditions may already satisfy it, so Partly for lacking a no-instruction baseline is debatable.
fields.doubt: A Q7 pede 'baseline ou alternativa' nas mesmas condições. Aqui há oito modelos e três scaffolds avaliados nas mesmas 217 instâncias. Decide se isso basta para Sim (1) ou se manténs Parcial por não haver condição sem instruções.
